task.title: Using the Virtual Camera
task.shortdesc: Send your OBS Studio output to other applications as if it were a webcam.

context.p: Virtual Camera makes OBS Studio's program output selectable as a camera source inside video-calling and conferencing applications.

step.cmd: Click Start Virtual Camera in the Controls panel.
In your conferencing application, open its camera selection menu.
Choose OBS Virtual Camera as the video source.

taskbody.result: The application now shows whatever OBS Studio's Program output is showing.
